description: Single classification registry for durable identities, TypeScript ownership, persistent families, and authored destination files. Validated by `bun run eidnara:check registry migration/registry.json`. Identity classes: frozen-durable (byte-level durable identity stays unchanged), external-protocol (wire, credential, schema, or tool-consumed identity stays unchanged), third-party. Family classes follow requirement R11. Waves add entries as their file inventories arrive. `fixture` entries: `byte-stable` paths change only through a reviewed contract change; `generator` paths reproduce one such fixture; `external-record` paths are machine-produced records about external systems.

entries.rationale: `PRAGMA user_version` of the direct format epoch.
Data-home environment variable that roots every persistent family path.
Lease sidecar file suffix; `FileLeaseStore::lease_path` appends it to the identity digest.
Fence table holding the single writer-epoch row that every fenced write and migration checks.
Per-namespace migration watermark table; a rename re-runs every migration.
Prefix of every per-module PostgreSQL database name (`eidnara_<slug>_<16hex>`).
Directory under the data home that holds every module store (`<data_home>/eidnara/<module_id>/store.db`).
Cache-stability golden vectors (schema_version 3). Byte-stable under R18: the bytes change only through a reviewed contract change.

Storage descriptor golden vectors: database names, store paths, and descriptor wire shape for eight sample module ids. Byte-stable under R18; regenerated only by the registered generator as part of a reviewed contract change.
Generator for the storage golden vectors; its module-id list is fixture content.
Generated by `scripts/eidnara-migration/registry-audit.ts`. It records raw `npm view`, `npm trust`, `npm token`, and `npm org` responses for the `@eidnara/*` package names.

entries.name: kernel-store
entries.rationale: Semantic kernel store. Identity: application id, user version, marker row, incarnation id, schema-component manifest digest, exact `sqlite_schema` inventory.
entries.probe: non-mutating open: PRAGMA application_id equals the registered Eidnara application id, PRAGMA user_version == 1, one format-marker row, sqlite_schema inventory equals fixtures/vocabulary/kernel-format-vocabulary-v1.json
entries.baseline_source: U4 composes one final baseline from the kernel schema components at the pinned host source commit and compares its identities to the captured vocabulary fixture
entries.restore_policy: current-format backup and restore only; no format import and no backfill path

entries.name: context-store
entries.rationale: Harness-facing context database. Written by transitional TypeScript storage until U5 moves authority to the daemon; keeps the U4 baseline and authoritative disposition through that move.
entries.probe: non-mutating open: PRAGMA application_id equals the registered Eidnara application id, PRAGMA user_version == 1, one format-marker row, sqlite_schema inventory equals fixtures/vocabulary/direct-format-vocabulary-v1.json
entries.baseline_source: U4 final baseline; direct-format vocabulary copied verbatim from the host source at the pinned commit
entries.restore_policy: current-format backup and restore only; reset is an explicit Doctor operation that quarantines, never a startup branch

entries.name: context-store-snapshots
entries.rationale: Backup and snapshot sidecars of `context.db`; they share its identity contract.

entries.name: module-store
entries.rationale: Module store opened by the daemon at `sqlite_store_path(data_home, module_id)`; U4 fixes its schema baseline.
entries.probe: non-mutating open: PRAGMA application_id equals the registered Eidnara application id, PRAGMA user_version == 1, one format-marker row, sqlite_schema inventory equals the captured kernel-format vocabulary
entries.baseline_source: U4 final baseline composed at the pinned host source commit

entries.name: artifact-cas
entries.rationale: Content-addressed artifact store. Identity is the content digest; no schema baseline beyond the on-disk layout.
entries.probe: digest of each artifact equals its address; layout version marker matches
entries.baseline_source: U4 records the CAS layout at the pinned host source commit
entries.restore_policy: included in current-format backup; referenced artifacts restore with the kernel store

entries.name: opencode-db
entries.rationale: Harness-owned database that Eidnara writes to but does not own (R39). No baseline, no backup or restore claim; the single-writer property applies only to Eidnara-owned families.
entries.probe: schema-compatibility probe before every write; refusal is reported as a non-failing event class

entries.name: purge-intent
entries.rationale: Kernel purge coordination log.

entries.name: window-reports
entries.rationale: Ledger derived from authoritative state.

entries.name: embedding-load-lock
entries.rationale: Embedding provider load coordination.

entries.name: host-locks
entries.rationale: Lifetime fence and transaction lock for the host process.

entries.name: retina-fenced-state
entries.rationale: Path-fenced coordination state for the retina subsystem.

entries.name: search-index
entries.rationale: Lexical search projection that kernel work creates; stays planned until the file exists.

entries.name: vector-projections
entries.rationale: Provider-dependent vector projections; rebuild requires stable provider identity and bounded prerequisites once created.

entries.name: test-fixtures
entries.rationale: Names that appear only in tests and fixtures: sample database files and the rendered store paths the storage-types tests assert.
